modern: The best way of taking revenge is not to become like the wrongdoer.
original: The best way of avenging thyself is not to become like [the wrong-doer].

explained.summary: The best revenge is not to become like the person who wronged you. Hitting back in kind just means they’ve changed you for the worse. Staying decent is the one response that leaves you better off than they are.
explained.today: When someone sends a snide email, the satisfying reply is usually an even snider one. Not sending it, and staying the kind of person who wouldn’t, is the version of getting even that doesn’t cost you anything.
